title: Triangulation of a dg category of modules closed under shifts and cones
statement:
Let $\mathcal B$ be a small cochain dg category over $\mathbf Z$ as in [lem-coef-dgcat-model-structure]. Use right dg modules, homogeneous module maps, their Hom differential, and the representable modules as in [lem-coef-dgcat-formal-cone-enlargement]. Work in universes large enough for the sets of modules used. Let $S$ be a set of labels, with a right dg module $M_s$ for each $s\in S$. Define a dg category $\mathcal C$ on $S$ by taking all homogeneous module maps between the labelled modules, with differential $\partial f=d_{M_t}f-(-1)^{|f|}fd_{M_s}$ and ordinary composition. Assume the following closure properties, each up to isomorphism of dg modules (a closed degree-zero module map with a strict inverse). The zero module is isomorphic to some $M_s$; for each $s,t$ the module $M_s\oplus M_t$ is isomorphic to some labelled module; for each $s$ and $n\in\mathbf Z$, the shift $M_s[n]$ is isomorphic to some labelled module, where $M[n]^j=M^{j+n}$, $d_{M[n]}=(-1)^n d_M$, and the right graded action is unchanged; and for each closed degree-zero map $f:M_s\to M_t$, its module cone $C(f)=M_t\oplus M_s[1]$, with differential $(y,x)\mapsto(dy+f(x),-dx)$, is isomorphic to some labelled module.

Then $H^0\mathcal C$, with morphisms the closed degree-zero module maps modulo the boundaries of degree-minus-one module maps, is triangulated in the sense of [def-weil-triangulated-category]. Its shift is induced by module shift and its distinguished triangles are precisely the triangles isomorphic to the cone triangles $M_s\xrightarrow{f}M_t\xrightarrow{i}C(f)\xrightarrow{-p}M_s[1]$, after choosing the indicated labelled representatives. These structures are independent up to the induced equivalence of these choices.
